title: UPDATE NOTICE: NOVEMBER 24
raw: [p]Attention Pilots,[/p][p align="start"]Mecha BREAK will undergo scheduled maintenance starting [b]November 24 at 12:00 (UTC+8)[/b]. Login and gameplay will be unavailable during maintenance. Estimated downtime: [b]6[/b] hours (subject to change—check official announcements for updates). Upon completion, all Pilots who log in within 14 days of maintenance will receive a routine maintenance package via mail (1,000 Mission Tokens, not counted toward seasonal accumulation).[/p][p align="start"]Below are the main changes in this update:[/p][p align="start"][/p][h2]New MOD Striker HURRICANE · Black Mamba Now Available[/h2][p align="start"]Shield up. Close in. Strike without warning. HURRICANE · Black Mamba will be available following the update.[/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780397/fea774cc3312de28c73819f467604b70eb3757c4.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][b]1. How to Obtain[/b][/p][p align="start"][b](1) How to Participate:[/b] Pilots can access \[Targeted Supply] from the \[Shop] and use \[Targeted Supply Keys] or \[Corite] to draw rewards.[/p][p align="start"][b](2) Supply Rewards:[/b] Rewards include Mod Parts and Aux Kits for \[HURRICANE · Black Mamba], HURRICANE-exclusive Striker Designs, Mod Kits, Modular Weapons, Aux Enhancement Modules, Gliders and Glider Aux, HURRICANE-exclusive paints, and currency exchange items.[/p][p align="start"][b](3) Targeted Supply Rules[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]Costs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Each draw costs 1 \[Targeted Supply Key].[/p][/*][*][p]If you do not have enough keys, you can cover the shortfall with \[Corite] at a rate of 50 \[Corite] per \[Targeted Supply Key].[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Obtaining Mod Parts[/b][/p][list][*][p]Each draw has a chance to award 1 of the 6 Mod Parts for \[HURRICANE · Black Mamba].[/p][/*][*][p]Obtain a new Mod Part in no more than 30 draws, with no duplicates. Each Mod Part you receive resets the draw counter.[/p][/*][*][p]Once you have collected all 6 Mod Parts, Mod Parts will no longer drop. All other rewards will continue to drop as usual.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Obtaining HURRICANE-Exclusive Striker Designs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Draws from \[HURRICANE · Black Mamba] Targeted Supply have a chance to award the exclusive Striker Designs \[HURRICANE · Frsot Raid] and \[HURRICANE · Gilded Rift].[/p][/*][*][p]You are guaranteed 1 HURRICANE-exclusive Striker Design within 60 draws.[/p][/*][*][p]Each exclusive Striker Design can only be obtained once.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b](4) Collection Rewards: [/b]Collect all 6 Mod Parts and unlock the modified stats to receive the exclusive \[Black Mamba] title and \[HURRICANE · Black Mamba] Striker Design as bonus rewards.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]2. How to Use[/b][/p][p align="start"][b](1) How to Use Mod Parts[/b][/p][list][*][p]Once you obtain a Mod Part, click it to use it directly. You can also use Mod Parts from your Inventory or via \[Striker Bay] > \[Striker Design] >
